How profitable has college basketball been in the last 5 years?

What’s in the Sources?

College Sports Finance
- Conference
  - Teams
- Revenue
  - Team sales
- Expenses
  - Travel
  - Student Aid
  - Etc

What’s missing?
- Missing a data code book
- Only does the division 1 programs who were willing to submit data
- Missing smaller school revenue
- Private school revenue is also missing
- No Meta data used
- The csv or data holder they used to build the site
- Missing years before 2018

What’s the limitation?
- Only schools who were d1 and willing to share their public information are in this set.
- Smaller schools were excluded so we will not have that data.

Degree and Relevance
- You could determine if overall a school is operating on a loss for their basketball program
- You could determine where a team is overspending as well
- Meta data for private schools and maybe some smaller schools for a better comparison

Ethical Soundness
- Doesn’t say if the schools had input from the personnel in their programs.
- Only in house data might be a slight concern.
- Missing private schools and small schools
- Not downloadable data, just a data dashboard
- Problematic if you want to use the data collected for other research questions.

Scope
- We have the conference , schools, programs (mens and womens), expenses, and revenue
- Schools in all the major conferences
- Are teams overspending?
